integrity: The split decomposition follows from the two valuation layers; twin classes classify all forcing sets; a rank-two bilinear witness is explicit; polynomial roots recover the algebraic size parameters.
scientific_limitations: Only nilpotency length three is covered.
Longer chain quotients have more valuation layers.
The polynomial recovers q and |I| but not ring or ideal isomorphism type.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
Graph-level chain-quotient parameter recovery has broader prior coverage.
title: Zero forcing polynomials of length-three ideal-based zero-divisor graphs
